channel.title: The Traitors
channel.desc: As the Traitors continue navigating their way through the game, they plot their next move in the dead of night. Breakfast dials up the pressure and brings fresh allegations to the table, but will anyone catch on? With attention focused on building the prize pot, today's mission requires the upmost trust amongst the players. As darkness descends over the castle, suspicions continue to rise at the Round Table - but can the Traitors deflect, or will the Faithful see through their lies?
